concerns.text: FR-001 (Baseline Analysis) is not fulfilled: tasks T012 (baseline analysis implementation) and T013 (record baseline metrics) remain incomplete, so no `data/processed/baseline_metrics.json` is produced despite the task list claiming to satisfy FR-001.
Constitution Principle VI requires a minimum of 1,000 bootstrap iterations. Task T037 permits reducing iterations to 500 when runtime exceeds 5 h, directly weakening the constitutional constraint.

The specification still contains the extraneous “LLM data quality reports” and “glioblastoma biomarkers” sections. Tasks T050/T050b, which are supposed to remove this text, are pending, leaving the spec contaminated and violating the requirement for a clean specification.

Spec‑amendment kickback tasks intended to lower the dataset‑count requirement (and document FR‑001 deviation) are not completed, so the spec’s dataset‑count constraint remains unmet, constituting a silent weakening of FR‑001/SC‑006.

Both tasks reference FR‑008 (stratification with ≥1 dataset per bin), but FR‑008 does not exist in the specification. This creates a mismatch between the task list and the spec, effectively weakening the documented requirements.
